newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Pannonplast raises capital in units.
newsitem.headline: Pannonplast raises capital in units.

text.p: Hungarian plastics group Pannonplast Muanyagipari Rt plastics group announced on Thursday that it raised share capital in two of its units.

Pannonplast raised capital in Almand Kft, its wholly owned subsidiary, to 544.52 million forints, by 400 million of which a real estate contribution represents 35 million and 365 million in cash, Pannonplast said.

"Almand Kft will build a new manufacturing plant and will make a considerable capacity expansion, widening its product mix for the household-chemical, pharmaceutical and cosmetics industry," Pannonplast said in a statement.
In another unit, Multicard Kft, Pannonplast implemented a capital increase of 200 million forints in cash, raising the capital to 250 million, with a 90 percent Pannonplast stake.

Multicard's expansion will bring about a new manufacturing plant and modern colour printing capacity, the company said, enabling them to meet growing demand for credit cards while meeting security regulations.
At a news conference on Wednesday Pannonplast said it raised share capital in Polifoam Kft, a third unit and simultaneously Germany's HT Troplast AG acquired a 17.9 percent stake.
On Wednesday Pannonplast shares closed at 5,100 forints, up 60, on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
